notes: «سئل ابن عباس وأبو هريرة» — Ibn Abbas and Abu Hurayra are asked and answer inside Abu Salama's account, a narrated encounter; they are not added, and whether they sit in the route is open
«فدخل أبو سلمة إلى أم سلمة فسألها» — the one asked answers, so Umm Salama is a link after Abu Salama (rule 5)
«- واللفظ لمحمد -» is a gloss, left out
